name: as_of_date
description: The snapshot date all features are computed at: 2026-09-01.

name: propensity_score
description: Modeled probability (0–1) that the customer books a warm-escape package in the 60 days after as_of_date, from the BigQuery ML logistic regression. Higher is more likely.

name: days_since_last_booking
description: Days from the most recent confirmed booking to as_of_date. NULL when the customer has never booked. Lapsed = 365 or more.

name: last_booking_date
description: Date of the most recent confirmed booking before as_of_date, or NULL.

name: loyalty_tier
description: Cymbal Compass tier: none, blue, silver or gold.

name: loyalty_status
description: As of as_of_date: active, lapsed or never.

name: home_market_climate
description: Climate group of the home market: cold (Chicago, Boston, Minneapolis, Detroit, Denver, Toronto, Cleveland, Milwaukee), warm (Miami, Phoenix, Houston, Los Angeles, San Diego) or mild (every other metro).

name: lifetime_bookings
description: Confirmed bookings on record before as_of_date.

name: lifetime_value_usd
description: Confirmed booking revenue before as_of_date, in US dollars.

name: ltv_band
description: Lifetime value band: none ($0), low (under $1,500), mid ($1,500–4,999), high ($5,000–11,999) or vip ($12,000 and up).

name: booked_last_60d
description: TRUE when the customer made a confirmed booking in the 60 days before as_of_date (a common suppression rule).

name: has_active_reservation
description: TRUE when the customer has a confirmed booking with travel on or after as_of_date.

name: email_contactable
description: TRUE when the customer can be emailed (opted in).

name: sms_contactable
description: TRUE when the customer can be texted (opted in).

name: sessions_last_90d
description: Signed-in web sessions in the 90 days before as_of_date (Jun 3 – Aug 31, 2026).

name: warm_views_last_90d
description: Sessions in the same 90 days in which a warm-escape destination was viewed.

name: recent_engagement_score
description: 0–1 score combining 90-day session count and days since the last session; 0 means no recent activity.
